plain_english: Having whirled, whirled — by the body swiftly, falling to earth: by the ceasing of agitation-power, the supreme state is born.
sanskrit_cite: bhrāntvā bhrāntvā śarīreṇa tvaritam bhuvi pātanāt | kṣobhaśaktivirāmeṇa parā saṃjāyate daśā

plain_english: On supports or by power, by knowing, or from mind-dissolving: born at power-penetration's end — the Bhairava form.
sanskrit_cite: ādhāreṣv athavā 'śaktyā 'jñānāc cittalayena vā | jātaśaktisamāveśakṣobhānte bhairavaṃ vapuḥ

plain_english: This tradition, O Goddess, hear — rightly I tell: even freedom is born at once, when the eyes are unwinkingly fixed.
sanskrit_cite: sampradāyam imam devi śṛṇu samyag vadāmy aham | kaivalyaṃ jāyate sadyo netrayoḥ stabdhamātrayoḥ

plain_english: Contraction of the ears having been made — at the lower gate likewise: unsmeared, unploughed, meditating, one may enter eternal brahman.
sanskrit_cite: saṃkocaṃ karṇayoḥ kṛtvā hy adhodvāre tathaiva ca | anackam ahalaṃ dhyāyan viśed brahma sanātanam

plain_english: At a well and such, a great pit — having stood above, from looking: of undivided mind rightly, at once mind-dissolving, plainly.
sanskrit_cite: kūpādike mahāgarte sthitvopari nirīkṣaṇāt | avikalpamateḥ samyak sadyas cittalayaḥ sphuṭam

plain_english: Wherever the mind goes — outside or inside, or even so: there, there Śiva-state — by pervasiveness: where would it go?
sanskrit_cite: yatra yatra mano yāti bāhye vābhyantare 'pi vā | tatra tatra śivāvāsthā vyāpakatvāt kva yāsyati

plain_english: Wherever by the eye's road, consciousness is manifested of the pervader: of him, from only-that-natured, from cit-dissolving — full-selfness.
sanskrit_cite: yatra yatrākṣamārgeṇa caitanyaṃ vyajyate vibhoḥ | tasya tanmātradharmitvāc cillayād bharitātmatā

plain_english: At hunger's end and such — in fear, in grief, in the abyss, or fled from battle; at curiosity-thirst's end: reality-being-full state.
sanskrit_cite: kṣutādyante bhaye śoke gahvare vā raṇād drute | kutūhalekṣudhādyante brahmasattāmayī daśā

plain_english: In things being remembered, when seen — in place, the mind should leave: one's own body unsupported made, the lord spreads forth.
sanskrit_cite: vastuṣu smaryamāṇeṣu dṛṣṭe deśe manas tyajet | svaśarīraṃ nirādhāraṃ kṛtvā prasarati prabhuḥ

plain_english: Anywhere, on a thing placed — slowly the gaze should withdraw: that knowing, mind-with — O Goddess, void-abode may it be.
sanskrit_cite: kvacid vastuni vinyasya śanair dṛṣṭiṃ nivartayet | taj jñānaṃ cittasahitaṃ devi śūnyālāyo bhavet
